NEW: zone-damage slot (hard-hit% × Z-Contact% — loud contact that actually meets hittable pitches), xwOBAcon contact quality, and HR-luck pairing (barrels-vs-HR xHR gap → DUE bats and HR-DUE arms). Also: hardened Savant fetch w/ cache validation, directional wind, EB shrinkage, platoon-split shape, pitch-mix fit + TRAP flags.
